title.original: A room that keeps its own hours

excerpt.original: Nightshift did not survive its own exhibition, and the record of it is better for having said so plainly.

gloss.en: Nightshift did not survive its own exhibition, and the record of it is better for having said so plainly.
gloss.da: Nightshift overlevede ikke sin egen udstilling, og optegnelsen af den er bedre af at have sagt det ligeud.
